gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.hallo: Hi! I'm the ranger of Beaver Brook. That's Spaander over there, my beaver. Want to know something, njeg?
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.aaien: Of course! Spaander loves a good pat. But he lives here with me: no taking him along and no taming. Want beavers of your own? At Safaripark Vadse Bergen you can get an enclosure sign for them.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.bus: Safaripark Vadse Bergen? The safari bus goes there, from a bus station here in the Guhmension. Check your Superkompas, or ask a travel guh. Lots more beavers live there, at a real beaver lodge!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.0: A beaver can gnaw down a little tree in a single night. Its teeth are orange from the iron in them: rock hard, njeg!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.1: Behind a beaver dam the water can't run away, so a pool forms. In it they build their lodge, with the front door under water. Clever, vads!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.2: Suddenly hear a SPLAT? That's a beaver slapping the water with its flat tail. It means: watch out, everybody inside!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.3: A beaver can stay under water for a whole quarter of an hour. I can't even manage ten seconds.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.4: Beavers don't eat fish, you know. Bark, leaves and water plants: a nibbling vegetarian!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.5: Their fur is so thick their skin never gets wet. They comb it with a split little claw on their hind foot.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.6: A beaver family works on one dam together, year after year. Just like a building crew of guhs!
gui.guhs.beverbeek.ranger.feit.7: See gnawed little stumps and paw prints? A beaver came by there. Just follow them to the water.
gui.guhs.beverbeek.aai.3: Spaander nibbles your sleeve for a moment. Sweet!
